title: On Necessary and Sufficient Conditions for Fixed Point Convergence: A Contractive Iteration Principle
summary: While numerous extensions of Banach's fixed point theorem typically offer only sufficient conditions for the existence and uniqueness of a fixed point and the convergence of iterative sequences, this study introduces a generalization grounded in the iterative contraction principle in complete metric spaces. This generalization establishes both the necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of a unique fixed point to which all iterative sequences converge, along with an accurate error estimate.
